summary: Iteration 311 - Testing 5 new features: Emergency Health Card (QR), Health Timeline (CuraLine), Medicine Interaction Guardian, One-Tap Post-Visit Pipeline, Express Rx Flow. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend pages load correctly with glassmorphic headers and floating glass bottom nav.

emergency_card: GET /api/emergency-card/8108888330 - Returns card data with all required fields
PUT /api/emergency-card/8108888330 - Updates blood group and allergies
health_timeline: GET /api/health-timeline/8108888330 - Returns events, grouped, stats, pagination
medicine_interactions: POST /api/medicine-interactions/check - Detects warfarin+aspirin high severity interaction
